provincial_scope.$comment: How a provincial unit's external.json scope (Spec 68 §6.1) maps to lot inputs (Spec 69 M-55 + notes 2026-10-07; M-60). Every provincial term is mapped explicitly; an unmapped term is a provincialUnits() violation. building_type: the 569-2013 types a provincial principal building type names (rowhouse = 569-2013 townhouse, 800.50(865)); a conditional entry (operator ruling (b) 2026-10-07) maps a houseplex type and its listed children only while the lot's house + ancillary units are ≤ max_lot_units — neither the Planning Act nor O. Reg. 299/19 defines the building types, so the mapping is inferred from City staff statements (cited) and flagged for the M-29 expert sample; a 4–6-plex never maps. land (operator ruling (c) 2026-10-07): an explicit lot flag wins; else a declared citywide default, except parcels on the cited exclusion list, which are unknown (not_evaluated:missing_input when it matters).

parcel_of_urban_residential_land.citation: Planning Act, R.S.O. 1990, c. P.13, s. 1(1) "parcel of urban residential land" (within an area of settlement, residential use permitted by by-law, served by municipal sewage works and a municipal drinking water system). Citywide default for lots in a 569-2013 residential zone: no primary citywide servicing statement exists (declared, not measured); Toronto Municipal Code Ch. 681 s. 681-11A(4) and Ch. 849 s. 849-14A show unsewered lots exist. Research: .cursor/mcbylaw/research-provincial-scope.md (2026-10-07).

definitions_matcher.$comment: Links a regulation's text to the Ch.800 terms it uses (Spec 68 §6.4 rule 11, G-READ). Case-insensitive, whole words, the term or its plural (+s / +es; y -> ies); a parenthetical in the term is dropped. Longer terms are matched first and their spans are not re-matched by a shorter term they contain ('Front Yard Setback' does not also count 'Front Yard'). A flip of any definition's used / not-used state changes the pinned universe and needs --accept --ruling.

Titles are the City's chapter names (569-2013 table of contents, pinned pages). zones lists the vocab.zone members of the category; [] = no MaxBLD residential zone.

article_application.$comment: Spec 69a M-219 (applies M-159): an Article's own application regulation. x.40.1(1) of each residential zone: the Article's regulations "apply to buildings or structures in the <zone> zone, other than ancillary buildings or structures which are subject to Article 10.5.60". A unit of that Article never answers for these building types (a garden or laneway suite is in an ancillary building, 150.7.20.1 / 150.8.20.1); its own chapter (150.7 / 150.8, 10.5.60) does. 10.5.40.1(1) is the same form for Article 10.5.40; 10.5.60.1(1) and R's 10.10.60.1(1) are the converse ("apply to ancillary buildings or structures"), so they list included_building_types instead. A unit of these Articles keyed on a principal type (e.g. 10.5.60.70(1)(C), 10.10.60.70(1)(C): "a lot with a detached houseplex") names the other building on the lot — a cross-structure condition this one-structure evaluation does not model (M-177(1), P2-10).

10.5.60.evidence: apply to ancillary buildings or structures

10.10.60.evidence: apply to ancillary buildings or structures in the R zone

10.10.40.evidence: other than ancillary buildings or structures

unit_application.$comment: Spec 69a M-251 (operator approved 2026-10-21, 2026-10-21-chat-batch-g#CHAT-29.F-SC-7): a unit whose own text names no building type but which the operator scoped to the residential building (the x.40.1(1) form of article_application, by unit id). applies() sets the unit aside for the listed building types, so an ancillary building takes its own Article 10.5.60 rule.

map_area_unheld_reading.$comment: Spec 69a M-222 / M-224: a map-gated unit whose map polygon is not held (lot.map_areas absent) takes the literal reading — the unit is set aside and its disclosure is attached — instead of not_evaluated:map_area_not_held on every lot. Listed units only; any other map-gated unit stays not_evaluated until its map is held.

150.7.60.30(1)#(1)(C).map: Coxwell–Victoria Park area (bylaw_map_areas polygon owed, M-193)

exception_type_alias.$comment: Spec 69a M-180(1): each zone's "Applicable Lot Requirements" (x.30.1(1)) and "Applicable Principal Building Requirements" (x.40.1) clauses: if an applicable Chapter 900 exception has requirements for a detached house (semi-detached house), the permitted detached houseplex (semi-detached houseplex) is subject to them. Read by applies() for exception-layer units only, on the classes the zone's clause names (RD names the detached houseplex only).

by_unit_count.$comment: Spec 69a M-252 (operator approved 2026-10-21, 2026-10-21-chat-batch-g#CHAT-29.F-SC-8): an exception clause written before By-law 648-2025 names a duplex or triplex; on the lot that is a detached houseplex of 2 or 3 dwelling units (vars.dwelling_units), and the clause binds it as its own type (not the M-180(1) substitution, so M-180(2) does not compare it).

label_absence_unregulated.$comment: Spec 69a M-220 / M-202(3): when no unit applies to the target and the lot's zone label carries no such letter, the answer is unregulated (no label cap), not no_candidate.

dwelling_units_max.statement: the zone label has no 'u', so the 'u' dwelling-unit cap does not apply

absence_ignore.$comment: Spec 68 §7.5 rule 7a (Spec 69 M-54 note): absence needs no by-law unit for the target. Operator chat 2026-10-20 batch B CHAT-8 (Spec 69a M-237): a unit that carries the target only for a lawfully existing building (its condition or lot_conditions name one of lot_conditions), or only for an ancillary building, a garden or laneway suite (every application.building_types entry in building_types), or only for an accessory structure (accessory_structure_uses: a vocab.accessory_structure_use in application.uses, M-159(2)) does not block absence for a new principal building. Rule 7a v2 (operator approved 2026-10-20, Spec 69a M-240): absence is decided per (zone, building type, target): a DEFINE unit with no statement for the target (define_without_statement) and a unit whose building_types exclude the lot's type and its parent (other_building_types) do not count either.

complement_phrases.$comment: Spec 69a M-242 (N-3, operator approved 2026-10-20): a unit whose own text holds one of these phrases may carry condition.if = complement(<sibling unit id>, …), the negation of each sibling arm's keyed condition; G-CLAUSE licenses its variables and literals from the sibling's clause (clause.mjs), the evaluator reads the sibling conditions resolved over the agreed units (agree.mjs resolveComplements).

accessory_structure_use.$comment: Spec 69a M-159 (2): a unit whose application.uses names one of these governs that structure, never the principal building; on a principal-building target it is set aside with this closed disclosure until the structure dimension (phase2-plan-v2 S.3) answers it.

scenario_class_units.$comment: Spec 69a M-160 (operator Q-D, 2026-10-15): dwelling-unit counts of the Layer 2 v1 P classes (scenario-classes.json, M-63 dated note 2026-10-14: P axis only, A = K = none). house_units = units in the principal building on the lot; ancillary_units = units in ancillary buildings (0 while A = none). undetermined_condition_disclosure.$comment: Spec 69a M-169 (operator 2026-10-15, envelope review): a condition no data source fills is taken as NOT holding (the permitted new build is answered); each unit set aside this way attaches 'If {condition}: {effect}.' with {condition} from this map and {effect} generated from the unit (its target measure, bound and value). Closed set: an uncovered undetermined token or input fails validation. lawfully_existing / existing_footprint_sqm use the specialised M-158 caveat. Data-filled (NOT covered): corner_lot, through_lot, major_street (parcels), threshold tokens (their if reads data, scenario or resolved inputs), exception_area (generated); scenario-filled: building_type, house_units, ancillary_units, unit_count, has_garden_suite, has_laneway_suite (M-160). M-172 (2026-10-15): this map holds SITE FACTS only (the builder cannot choose them); DESIGN CHOICES are in design_choice_disclosure.

design_choice_disclosure.$comment: Spec 69a M-172 (operator 2026-10-15, review of 600.60.40(2)(A)): a condition the builder controls. For the theoretical max build, a PERMISSIVE unit (raises a max / lowers a min) is taken as met and the answer carries achieved_template; a RESTRICTIVE unit is not applied to the answer and is shown only as restrictive_template (the trade-off). Every non-threshold, non-generated lot_condition token and every user_input is in exactly one of: data_filled / scenario_filled / specialised (M-158) / undetermined_condition_disclosure (site facts) / design_choice_disclosure (test-locked).
